u1304.gist: Bihar news shorts: NeVA launched in the Bihar Assembly, India's largest battery-based solar plant at Kajra, Bihar first in ABDM, and Bihar declared Naxal-free.

Bihar's first supercomputer 'PARAM Rudra' at IIT Patna, under the National Supercomputing Mission (NSM).
Bihar declared Naxal-free after the last armed Maoist, Suresh Koda, surrendered in Munger.
